source_reference: Gemini AI inference and decision logging proposal supplied by the user on 2026-08-21
source_manifest_reference: Complete bounded proposal text in the conversation

items.source_item: No artefact without complete reproducible traceability
items.rationale: Traceability is retained for consequential engineering artefacts, but evidence depth is proportionate to intended use, consequence and active domain profile. Bit-identical reproduction is not promised for uncontrollable hosted inference.
items.protected_outcome: Auditable provenance without false reproducibility claims
items.verification_reference: Evidence profiles E0 through E2 and decision-record validator
items.follow_up_trigger: AI can affect an engineering artefact or assurance conclusion

items.source_item: Any AI influence automatically makes the AI tool qualification-auditable
items.rationale: Qualification depends on declared use, possible error impact, downstream error detection, eliminated activities, assurance level and domain rules. Automatic qualification would add unsupported cost while still failing to analyse the actual use.
items.verification_reference: FAA AC 20-115D and EASA tool-use and error-detection criteria
items.follow_up_trigger: A project proposes reliance on AI output or reduced verification

items.source_item: Archive complete system and user prompts
items.rationale: Controlled prompt versions are retained by hash and access-controlled reference. Full content is stored only when necessary, lawful, licensed, classified and covered by retention rules; unrestricted audit-log duplication is prohibited.
items.protected_outcome: Instruction provenance with privacy, IP and secret protection
items.verification_reference: Capture-mode validator rejects embedded raw content
items.follow_up_trigger: A project defines its evidence and retention profile

items.intent: Reconstruct the evidence supplied to the model
items.rationale: The required retrieval manifest records source IDs, editions, applicability, element or clause references, source hashes and retrieval configuration. Verbatim chunks are retained only when necessary and permitted by licence, privacy and classification.
items.protected_outcome: Retrieval provenance without unlawful content copying
items.follow_up_trigger: An authorised project RAG implementation exists

items.source_item: Always record exact model weight hash and quantisation
items.rationale: Local models require exact artefact hash, quantisation and runtime. Hosted models use the provider-exposed model/version, request reference, region and admission evidence; unavailable weight hashes must not be invented.
items.verification_reference: Controlled weight-identity modes and negative hash test
items.follow_up_trigger: A model is admitted for an engineering task class

items.rationale: Temperature zero does not control provider updates, kernels, hardware, batching, floating-point effects or retrieval changes. Parameters are recorded, but limitations and original decision evidence remain mandatory.
items.protected_outcome: No false determinism or replay claims

items.source_item: Archive the raw model output before filtering
items.intent: Preserve the actual candidate produced by AI
items.rationale: E1 and E2 require a hashed controlled raw-output reference. Content stays in the classified project evidence store and follows access and retention decisions rather than a general log.
items.follow_up_trigger: AI creates a candidate engineering artefact

items.source_item: Log validators, parsing errors and automatic re-prompts
items.intent: Make transformations and correction loops auditable
items.rationale: Validation and transformation event evidence is required by controlled reference. Retry counts and failures remain bounded by the processing envelope and cannot conceal the original candidate.
items.follow_up_trigger: An AI route performs validation, correction or transformation

items.source_item: Log Presidio masking and deanonymisation token replacements
items.rationale: Event logs may reference stable tokens and rule outcomes, but reversible mappings stay in a separately protected vault. General audit logs must not become a re-identification database.
items.follow_up_trigger: An admitted pseudonymisation service is piloted

items.source_item: Reviewer ID, timestamp and final diff prove human approval
items.rationale: Identity and diff are necessary but insufficient. The record also requires competence, independence, scope, criteria, deterministic evidence, anomalies, limitations and a decision tied to the exact baseline.
items.follow_up_trigger: A candidate is proposed for declared engineering use

items.source_item: TUV, DEKRA, FDA, EASA and EBA as example certification authorities
items.rationale: Stakeholders are project-specific and have different legal roles. EBA is the European Banking Authority; the European Union Agency for Railways is ERA. Assessment organisations and public authorities are not interchangeable.
items.verification_reference: Authority correction section and project applicability gate
items.follow_up_trigger: A project profile names an authority, assessor or certification route
